children.text: I wrote a podcast on gentrification in Houston, Texas and how it has led to displacement in its surrounding suburbs, like Sugar Land. I argued that community solutions, including better tenant laws and investing in nonprofit organizations, have the potential to protect vulnerable residents. I used rhetorical appeals like ethos by sharing my personal connection to Sugar Land, and logos by including real neighborhood solutions as evidence. The podcast was aimed at residents and policymakers who may not realize the long-term impact of gentrification on long-term residents. This issue connects directly to my argument because it shows how urban development can sometimes harm the communities it claims to improve.
